data.title: Web3 Wallet Drainer — Malicious Token Approval to Drainer Contract
data.description: Detects wallet drainer approval phishing by identifying three high-confidence on-chain indicators: (1) token approval (approve() or increaseAllowance()) granting unlimited allowance to a contract address on known drainer threat feeds, (2) unlimited ERC-20 approvals to contracts deployed within the last 48 hours with no verified source code, or (3) rapid multi-token approvals (3+ distinct token contracts) from a single wallet to the same spender address within a 10-minute window — characteristic of automated DaaS kit multi-token harvesting. ScamSniffer reported $494M stolen via wallet drainers in 2024, with Inferno Drainer commanding 40-45% DaaS market share. The Permit/Permit2 gasless signature variant bypasses traditional on-chain approval monitoring; this rule covers the on-chain approve() path and Permit2 batch transfer events. Stolen assets are typically consolidated and bridged cross-chain within hours.

enrichment_required.source: Hours since spender contract deployment (block timestamp of contract creation tx)
Boolean flag from Etherscan/Sourcify indicating verified source code
Threat feed of known drainer contract addresses (ScamSniffer, Forta, SlowMist)
Estimated USD value of all token holdings in the approving wallet

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Web3 Wallet Drainer Approval Detection
// Detects malicious token approvals: known drainers, unlimited to new contracts, rapid multi-token
(method_selector="0x095ea7b3" OR method_selector="0x39509351" OR method_selector="0x30f28b7a")
| match(spender_address, file="known_drainer_contracts.csv", field="address", strict=false)
  OR (approval_amount="0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff"
      AND spender_contract_age_hours<=48
      AND spender_contract_verified=false)
| groupBy(from_address, span=10m, function=[
    count(distinct=token_contract_address, as=distinct_tokens),
    collect([tx_hash, spender_address, token_contract_address, approval_amount, block_timestamp])
  ])
| distinct_tokens >= 3 OR _matched = true
| sort(block_timestamp, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Web3 Wallet Drainer Approval Detection")`
`comment("Detects malicious token approvals to drainer contracts or suspicious new contracts")`
index=flame_blockchain sourcetype=flame:chain_monitoring
  (method_selector="0x095ea7b3" OR method_selector="0x39509351" OR method_selector="0x30f28b7a")
| lookup known_drainer_contracts spender_address AS spender_address OUTPUT is_known_drainer
| eval is_unlimited = if(approval_amount="0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff", 1, 0)
| eval is_new_unverified = if(spender_contract_age_hours<=48 AND spender_contract_verified="false", 1, 0)
| eval drainer_match = if(is_known_drainer="true", 1, 0)
| bin _time span=10m
| stats count AS approval_count,
    dc(token_contract_address) AS distinct_tokens,
    values(token_contract_address) AS tokens_approved,
    values(tx_hash) AS tx_hashes,
    max(drainer_match) AS has_drainer_match,
    max(is_unlimited) AS has_unlimited,
    max(is_new_unverified) AS has_new_unverified
    by from_address, spender_address, _time
| where has_drainer_match=1 OR (has_unlimited=1 AND has_new_unverified=1) OR distinct_tokens>=3
| eval risk_level = case(
    has_drainer_match=1, "critical",
    distinct_tokens>=5, "critical",
    has_unlimited=1 AND has_new_unverified=1, "high",
    distinct_tokens>=3, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| sort - risk_level
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Web3 Wallet Drainer Approval Detection
-- Detects malicious token approvals: known drainers, unlimited to new contracts, rapid multi-token
WITH approval_events AS (
  SELECT
    t.tx_hash,
    t.block_timestamp,
    t.from_address AS victim_wallet,
    t.spender_address,
    t.token_contract_address,
    t.approval_amount,
    t.chain_id,
    d.is_known_drainer,
    c.contract_deploy_timestamp,
    c.is_verified AS spender_contract_verified,
    DATEDIFF(HOUR, c.contract_deploy_timestamp, t.block_timestamp) AS spender_age_hours
  FROM token_approvals t
  LEFT JOIN known_drainer_contracts d ON t.spender_address = d.contract_address
  LEFT JOIN contract_metadata c ON t.spender_address = c.contract_address
  WHERE t.block_timestamp >= DATEADD(HOUR, -24, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.method_selector IN ('0x095ea7b3', '0x39509351', '0x30f28b7a')
),
rapid_multi_approvals AS (
  SELECT
    victim_wallet,
    spender_address,
    MIN(block_timestamp) AS window_start,
    MAX(block_timestamp) AS window_end,
    COUNT(DISTINCT token_contract_address) AS distinct_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS approval_count
  FROM approval_events
  GROUP BY victim_wallet, spender_address
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT token_contract_address) >= 3
    AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MIN(block_timestamp), MAX(block_timestamp)) <= 10
)
SELECT
  a.tx_hash,
  a.block_timestamp,
  a.victim_wallet,
  a.spender_address,
  a.token_contract_address,
  a.approval_amount,
  a.chain_id,
  CASE
    WHEN a.is_known_drainer = TRUE THEN 'KNOWN_DRAINER'
    WHEN a.approval_amount = '0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff'
         AND a.spender_age_hours <= 48
         AND a.spender_contract_verified = FALSE THEN 'UNLIMITED_NEW_UNVERIFIED'
    WHEN r.victim_wallet IS NOT NULL THEN 'RAPID_MULTI_APPROVAL'
  END AS detection_reason,
  a.spender_age_hours,
  a.spender_contract_verified
FROM approval_events a
LEFT JOIN rapid_multi_approvals r
  ON a.victim_wallet = r.victim_wallet AND a.spender_address = r.spender_address
WHERE a.is_known_drainer = TRUE
  OR (a.approval_amount = '0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff'
      AND a.spender_age_hours <= 48
      AND a.spender_contract_verified = FALSE)
  OR r.victim_wallet IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.block_timestamp DESC

references: ScamSniffer, 2024 Web3 Phishing Report — $494M stolen via wallet drainers
Chainalysis, 2025 Crypto Crime Report — $16.1B in CMLN processing
Elliptic, Drainer-as-a-Service Research — DaaS smart contract architecture
Forta Network, On-Chain Threat Detection — wallet drainer alert feeds
Arkham Intelligence illicit wallet tag database (intel.arkm.com/tags/suspicious) — open-source drainer wallet address attribution and flagging
falsepositives: Legitimate DeFi protocol interactions requiring unlimited approval (Uniswap, Aave, Compound) — mitigated by verified contract whitelist
Newly deployed contracts from legitimate protocol upgrades — mitigated by source code verification check
Power users batch-approving tokens for a new DeFi protocol launch
